Notes: Target MCU. Reball/desolder from eCTF board OR buy new (then it is a methodology target, not the eCTF part).
VCORE decoupling. REQUIRED by datasheet, place hard against pin 80 / VSS.
Bulk, on the SUPPLY side of the shunt (FILT_OUT). Reduce/remove to widen measurement bandwidth for SCA.
Optional LOCAL shunt. Populate (e.g. 1-10 ohm) to measure right at the VDD pins; then do NOT also use the CW308/CW313 shunt.
Optional nRST pull-up; CW308 already pulls nRST up via VREF.
ARM 2x5 SWD debug header (XDS110/J-Link) - same debug interface as the MSP-LITO board. 1=VTREF,2=SWDIO,4=SWCLK,10=nRESET,odd=GND.
nRST push-button (like the LITO NRST button).
Jumper crossings (single-sided). Solder 0603/1206 0-ohm for <=3.5mm, short wire for JP4/JP8/JP9. See JUMPERS.txt.
